title: Gluing trivial module lines along a cocycle
statement: Let X be a ringed space and U_i an open cover. Given isomorphisms between the restrictions of the unit module on each overlap, satisfying the cocycle equation on every open contained in a triple overlap, there is a sheaf of modules H on X whose restriction to every U_i is isomorphic to the unit module.

proof.text: Apply the existing module sheaf gluing theorem to the family of unit modules and the supplied transition isomorphisms. Its cocycle hypothesis is exactly the displayed triple-overlap equality, and its local comparison isomorphisms identify the glued module with each unit module.

lean.statement:
theorem glue_trivial_module_lines
    (X : RingedSpace.{u, u}) (I : Type w) (U : I → Opens X)
    (hcover : ⨆ i, U i = ⊤)
    (φij : ∀ i j : I,
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
        (homOfLE inf_le_left : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U i)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X).over (U i))) ≅
      (SheafOfModules.overMap (moduleRings X)
        (homOfLE inf_le_right : U i ⊓ U j ⟶ U j)).obj
          (SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X).over (U j))))
    (hcocycle : ∀ (i j k : I) (W : Opens X)
      (hi : W ≤ U i) (hj : W ≤ U j) (hk : W ≤ U k),
      (φij i k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hk)))) =
        (φij i j).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hi hj)))) ≫
          (φij j k).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE (le_inf hj hk))))) :
    ∃ (H : SheafOfModules (moduleRings X)),
      ∀ i : I, Nonempty (H.over (U i) ≅
        SheafOfModules.unit ((moduleRings X).over (U i)))
